theme: An open day with a few clocks quietly running.
greeting: Good evening, Dan. After a 9 o'clock appointment the calendar stayed clear all day, so the things worth your attention are off the calendar: two bookings with deadlines on them and a governance note waiting for a reply.

needsAttention.title: OECD November meeting invite
needsAttention.detail: A governance colleague wrote this morning inviting you to the OECD corporate-governance meeting in November and flagging a few things to line up. The note has been sitting since morning and is waiting on your reply.

needsAttention.title: Decide and book the December trip
needsAttention.detail: Your own note sets a book-by date of October 15 - two days out - for the all-four-kids December break. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the window is real.

needsAttention.title: Hold a refundable Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Flagged book-this-week back in September and still open. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out; a refundable hold now costs nothing and takes the risk off the table.

flagged.title: BlackRock reconnect still open
flagged.detail: Your Oct 8 note to John Roe about still being in the market hasn't come back yet.

flagged.title: Eugenia wants a date to talk
flagged.detail: She's back October 31 and asked you to pick a slot - possibly around ICGN in Toronto.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley account funding
flagged.detail: A 'final reminder' to fund your new Signature Savings account.

inbox.noise: The usual newsletters and a LinkedIn job alert for a state-government-affairs role.

resolved.title: Vinalhaven ferry tickets
resolved.detail: Confirmed yesterday and forwarded to Mike.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn's chestnuts and winter squash are at their peak right now, worth the slow braise.

acts.line: A single 9 o'clock appointment, then the morning fell entirely open.
Nothing scheduled - a rare clear stretch with no meetings to work around.
The girls are with Jen tonight, so the kitchen and the quiet are yours.
